answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds leveraging zero-knowledge verifiable delay and staking collateral secured in a vault to establish cryptoeconomic security primitives. Our capital barrier analysis proves subgame-perfect slashing penalties ensure expected Sybil multiplication payoffs are strictly negative, driving adversarial capital toward its nadir. Thus, deploying yarrow to forge identities yields negative expected attack utility, guaranteeing Nash equilibrium convergence against all adversarial multi-agent environments.
